# Tangent cut from left

Reduced from CAD-Recode validation stem `11`. The blank is 10 × 8 × 5. The
radius-2 through bore at (-3, 0) is tangent to one side. The area subtracts
two discs and adds the cylindrical wall.

`oracle.json` records this program on CadQuery 2.3.0 and Open CASCADE
7.9.3.0.

Adapted from CAD-Recode validation by Danila Rukhovich, Elona Dupont,
Dimitrios Mallis, Kseniya Cherenkova, Anis Kacem and Djamila Aouada.
